scope: Source-only native firmware update implementation; synthetic candidates and mocked flashing jobs

checks.function_documentation: All 19 assigned Python sources pass intent and parameter checks

verified_behaviors: Standard HA update.install awaits a verified durable result instead of submission acceptance
Real authenticated native HTTP and WebSocket snapshots connect HA to an isolated durable job ledger
Lost submission replies are resolved using the same request ID without another POST
Observation cancellation and timeout do not cancel or replay daemon firmware jobs
Rejected and unknown outcomes raise HA service errors
Daemon metadata remains readable without a firmware candidate or during radio maintenance
Web-started job state is restored after HA integration reload
Old daemons without firmware metadata retain switch support
Native firmware route rejects caller paths, URLs, extra fields and oversized bodies
Candidate IDs allow 256 characters, request IDs 128; 161-character catalog identities pass end to end
Native snapshots omit private worker data and disable controls during active or recovery-required maintenance
Only measured overall progress is displayed; optional backup and arbitrary version selection are unsupported
App bootstrap rejects symlinked firmware lock files
not_performed: Physical radio firmware flashing or recovery
Rebuilding or running the updated app container
payload_delivery: The checked source manifest contains no firmware artifacts; no candidate means no installation capability
